recommendation_summary: Add a single dead-man check: nightly-sync pings an external health-check service on success, and the service alerts the user if no ping arrives by morning.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to catch a dead nightly-sync without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central log on Synology, Dockerizing everything.
labels.Bottleneck: Crash before the email step sends nothing, so failure looks like nothing happened.
labels.Checked myself: You told me edna cron 03:00 emails only on finish, failed 4 nights silent, with no other alert.

note: The reply recommends one hosted dead-man alert, rejects the central log and Docker, and the Checked myself line attributes its facts to the user.
